description: Debt payoff planner (avalanche vs snowball) — Plan paying off several debts: simulates avalanche (highest APR first) and snowball (smallest balance first) with minimums rolling over, plus minimums-only baseline. Returns debt-free month and date, total interest, payoff order with dates, interest and months saved, a recommendation and warnings when a minimum does not cover interest. Required: debts=name:balance:apr:minimum separated by | (up to 20). Optional: extra= (extra $/month), start=YYYY-MM. Offline math. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_debt_payoff
